h1: Custom Full Color Towels for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color towels with vibrant sublimation. Perfect for giveaways, sports, or promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color towels let you reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with photographic detail. Unlike screen-printed towels limited to a few colors, sublimation transfers dye directly into the fabric, resulting in a soft hand and fade-resistant graphics. From 15" x 18" rally towels for stadium giveaways to 22" x 42" bench towels for gyms, full color decoration gives you the flexibility to match any brand palette or event theme. Ideal for marketing directors and safety managers who need high-impact promotional items that stand out.
heroAltText: Custom full color towels with vibrant sublimated logo, perfect for promotional giveaways and sports events.
